facts.raw_span: A 47-year-old man
no significant medical history
his father was diagnosed with COVID-19
general malaise without fever or respiratory symptoms
ST-segment elevation on electrocardiogram
Cardiopulmonary arrest occurred during transport to hospital
No coronary artery sclerosis or stenosis was observed
Elevated cardiac markers (troponin and brain natriuretic peptide)
Thrombopenia
SARS-CoV-2 antigen test positive (>5000 pg/mL) from oropharyngeal swab
Dorsal pulmonary infiltrative shadow and bilateral pleural effusions
diffuse contraction band necrosis with several lymphocytes in cardiac muscle
